text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup, and
the name on everyone's lips
is...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Just look at her! You'd think she
was a
senior the way she carries herself.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's just as good! She's got tons
of wins
under her belt. I'd bet anything
she becomes the
queen of the new
generation.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's right! Send me your
dreams, big and
small!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's bold 'n' passionate—another true
city girl.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I guess I've met a lotta city girls up till
now, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(They're all so unabashedly themselves...
But
they've got their own problems too.
In that way,
we're kinda similar.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But it's how they work through their
troubles that
makes 'em shine even
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Which means I can shine too, long as I
do the
same.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna beat Hishiama 'n' shine brighter
than
everyone else today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone the dazzl'n city girl
I've been
dream'n of!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I can't put my finger on it, but something
tells me
Yukino Bijin is the one to watch
today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She was getting on my nerves last year
with her
being all anyone could talk
about, but... I have a
feeling she'll do
well today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Let's see what the Snow Angel's got.
